title: gesneria × naegelioides
intro: Gesneria × naegelioides, commonly known as the Gesneria hybrid or "Mexican Petunia", is a perennial plant species native to Mexico and Central America. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, headache, and digestive issues. The plant exhibits therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. Bioactive constituents of Gesneria × naegelioides include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
